labels.shortDescription: Health Check: Gift Transaction mirror has not run, detail
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror's nightly run is scheduled, but no run has completed since {0}. It runs as the person who scheduled it: if they were deactivated or lost access, every run fails before it starts. Open Gift Transaction mirror in BarnCRM Settings, then stop the nightly run and schedule it again as someone who can run it. The Error Log says why the runs failed.

This org has no Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transactions you can use, so there is nothing to mirror. The Gift Transaction mirror needs Nonprofit Cloud fundraising and, for you, the Fundraising User permission. It is also unavailable when this org's Gift Transaction fields differ from what this version of BarnCRM expects.
The Gift Transaction mirror is off. Choose a direction in BarnCRM Settings, Giving, Gift Transaction mirror direction.

labels.shortDescription: Not ready: no paid status set
labels.value: Nothing is mirrored until you set Gift Transaction mirror paid status in BarnCRM Settings, Giving: the Status your paid Gift Transactions have.

labels.shortDescription: Not ready: paid status is not an active Status value
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror paid status, {0}, is not one of the active Status values of Gift Transactions in this org, so nothing is mirrored. Copy the value exactly, as its API name, from the Status field in Setup.

labels.shortDescription: Not ready: no start date set
labels.value: Nothing is mirrored until you set Gift Transaction mirror start date in BarnCRM Settings, Giving. Only gifts and Gift Transactions dated on or after it are mirrored.
Starting or scheduling the mirror needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: cannot do what a run needs
labels.value: You cannot create, edit or read Gift Transactions as this direction needs, or you do not have the Gift Transaction Mirror permission set, so a run started by you would mirror nothing.

labels.shortDescription: Page refused: no Gift Transaction Mirror permission set
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror page needs the Gift Transaction Mirror permission set. Ask your administrator for it.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: a run is in progress
labels.value: A run is already in progress. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

labels.shortDescription: Page refusal: copy again needs Gifts to Gift Transactions
labels.value: Copy these gifts again works only in Gifts to Gift Transactions: a gift is never changed from its Gift Transaction.
Something went wrong. The Error Log has the details.
The Gift Transaction mirror run did nothing, because automation is paused on the Automation page. The next run after it resumes catches up.
The Gift Transaction mirror run did nothing, because the Gift Transaction mirror is switched off on the Automation page. Switch it on for its runs to work again.

labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror left some records for the next run, because copying them in the same transaction would have gone past Salesforce limits. The next run copies them.

labels.shortDescription: Run log: gift has no account to be the donor
labels.value: The gift has no Donor Account and no Household, and a Gift Transaction's donor must be an account. Give the donor a household, and the next run copies the gift.

labels.shortDescription: Run log: linked Gift Transaction not found
labels.value: The Gift Transaction linked to the gift was deleted or is not visible to you. If it was deleted, clear the gift's Gift Transaction ID to have a new one made; if it still exists, give the person running the mirror access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Gift save refused: Gift Transaction ID is not one
labels.value: Gift Transaction ID must be the record ID of a Nonprofit Cloud Gift Transaction (15 or 18 characters), or empty.

labels.shortDescription: Run log: new Gift Transaction left unlinked
labels.value: The Gift Transaction mirror created the Gift Transaction {0} for this gift, could not store its Gift Transaction ID on the gift, and could not delete the Gift Transaction again: {1} Delete that Gift Transaction, or paste its ID onto the gift once the gift can be saved.

labels.shortDescription: Run log: Gift Transaction amount not above zero
labels.value: The Gift Transaction has no Original Amount above zero, so no gift was made from it.

labels.shortDescription: Run log: Gift Transaction names no donor account
labels.value: The Gift Transaction has no donor account, so no gift was made from it. Give it a donor, and the next run makes the gift.

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift: its Gift Transaction is left in place
labels.value: Its Gift Transaction is left in place. Delete it in Nonprofit Cloud yourself if it should go.

labels.shortDescription: Deleted gift: its Gift Transaction will become a gift again
labels.value: Its Gift Transaction is left in place, and while it has the paid status the next run makes a new gift from it. Change its status, or delete it, if the gift should stay gone.
